title: Panama Canal to Reduce Daily Ship Traffic as El Niño Drives Drought
author: Michael Chen
image: /images/news/We have more work to do', says Canada negotiator as US trade deadline looms category business.webp
excerpt: The Panama Canal will reduce daily ship transits from September as severe El Niño conditions and below-average rainfall threaten water supplies and global shipping routes.

title: US Diesel Prices Hit Record $5.85 a Gallon as Global Fuel Crisis Deepens
author: Business Desk
excerpt: US diesel prices have reached a record high near $5.85 a gallon as Middle East and Russian refinery disruptions squeeze global fuel supplies.

title: Shein Sets $27 Billion Valuation Target for Hong Kong IPO as Growth Slows
author: Sarah Jenkins
image: /images/news/Shein aims for almost 27bn valuation in stock market debut.webp
excerpt: Fast-fashion giant Shein is targeting a valuation of almost $27 billion in its September 1 Hong Kong IPO, far below its previous $100 billion private-market peak.

title: Japanese Companies Expand in India as Businesses Reduce Dependence on China
author: Business Desk
image: /images/news/Japan Inc is betting big on India as China risks deepen.webp
excerpt: Japanese companies are expanding investment in India as geopolitical tensions, supply-chain concerns and rising business risks in China push firms to diversify across Asia.

author: Business Desk
